newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Erkki Liikanen and Belgian Minister for Public Services Andre Flahaut would hold a joint news conference on "Berlaymont 2000" at 1100/0900 GMT on Tuesday.
In answer to a question, Vale de Almeida said there were no new developments in the illegally exported UK beef case.

Spokesman Willy Helin said that the uninimous negative opinion by the 15 member states' competition experts on the Boeing-McDonell Douglas merger proposal did not bind the Commission. "The ball is now in the Boeing camp", Helin added.

Spokeswoman Lousewies van der Laan said the Commission opinions on candidates for EU accession would be released at 0900/0700 GMT on July 16 on the Internet. She also said Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Hans van den Broek would hold a joint news conference at 1200/1000 GMT in Strasbourg.
The Commission released the following documents:
- Eurostat news release No 48/97: EU annual inflation remains at 1.5%.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and industry No 1997-15: EU hard coal and coke imports 1994-1996.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - ECU-EMS information & central bank interest rates No 6-1997.
